meta_022.purpose: Grid search over dir_acc thresholds to find config maximizing decision accuracy + positive pnl_delta

grid_search_results.no_config_meets_both: accuracy >= 60% AND pnl_delta > 0 — all configs fail accuracy threshold

key_findings: REVERSE threshold has ZERO effect — all REVERSE signals have dir_acc=0% (extreme), below ALL reverse thresholds
CONFIRM threshold has minimal effect — most CONFIRM signals have dir_acc=100% (extreme), above ALL confirm thresholds
Decision accuracy FLOOR at 57.1% — hardcoded by 30% NO_DATA rate (dir_acc exactly = 0.5)
NO_DATA signals: all return base_pnl (fallback), so accuracy depends on underlying trade profitability

accuracy_analysis.root_cause: REVERSE threshold insensitive because synthetic data has extreme dir_acc values (0% or 100%)

meta_022.phase4_recommendation: P&L delta should be primary metric (not accuracy). +27.56% pnl_delta on synthetic data validates meta-labeling value independent of accuracy threshold.
meta_022.next: meta_023 — Document this finding; explore alternative accuracy metric (e.g., weighted accuracy excluding NO_DATA, or per-decision accuracy)
